explain.Building the tunnels and stations: The construction cost, spent evenly over the twelve years of works.
explain.Renewing the rail systems every thirty y: Track, power and signalling of the tunnels replaced in 2070, 2100 and 2130.
explain.Running the tunnels and stations: Upkeep, power, staff and safety of the tunnels and the four stations, every year.
explain.Running the extra regional trains: Regional express trains run through Paris instead of ending at a terminal, which costs more train-km, and RER G trains take 2 minutes more for the Châtelet stop.
explain.TGV travellers of the Paris region: a ne: Passengers who start or end in the Paris region board at the station nearest to them, since every direction is served from three stations.
explain.TGV travellers crossing Paris: no change: The passengers who today change station in Paris, by metro, RER or taxi, stay on their train; the time and the change saved, and the journeys this makes possible.
explain.Room for more TGVs in the busy hours: As traffic grows, today’s terminals would turn journeys away in the busy hours; the through stations carry them. Nothing in the opening year.
explain.Regional travellers: the Paris side of t: Suburban and regional express passengers reach the Paris station on the far side of the centre without the metro.
explain.Suburb-to-suburb trips across Paris, rou: The rough corridor estimate of the official list, replaced by the commuters measured on the census.
explain.Regional express travellers crossing Par: Regional express passengers from the north and the east run on to the south and the west instead of changing terminal.
explain.Comfort on relieved lines, ratio of anot: The comfort ratio borrowed from the Grand Paris appraisal, replaced by the crowding count.
explain.Fares of the new TGV journeys kept by th: On each new journey the operator keeps a margin and the track owner its charges net of wear; the French method counts both as a gain.
explain.Trainsets saved: trains no longer wait i: Trains that run through instead of waiting in a terminal need fewer trainsets for the same service.
explain.Upkeep of the surface terminals no longe: The surface throats and track fields that close no longer need maintenance.
explain.Carbon: car trips replaced by the new TG: A quarter of the new TGV journeys replace a car trip, at the official value of a tonne of carbon.
explain.Roads: fewer accidents, less noise, poll: Fewer car-km mean fewer accidents, less noise, pollution and congestion, at the official values.
explain.Cost of raising the public money: Each euro of net public money counts 1.2, because raising taxes has a cost of its own.
explain.Commuters who gain a through suburban li: Commuters between the suburbs on both sides of Paris who gain a through suburban line, measured on the census and the timetable.
explain.Building plots at the edge of the freed: The small plots kept for building at the edge of the freed tracks, sold at the price SNCF got at Bercy-Charenton and Gare des Mines.
explain.Four new parks on the freed tracks: Three large parks on the freed tracks: the visits they draw and the health they bring, less what they cost to make and keep.
explain.Less crowding on the metro and RER legs: Passengers who reach the far side of Paris on their train no longer ride a crowded metro or RER leg; the riders left on board gain room too. RER G is counted on its own.
explain.RER G stops at Ch\u00e2telet-Les Halles:: RER G stops at Châtelet-Les Halles between Nord-Est and Montparnasse: its riders change there to RER A, B and D and metro lines 1, 4, 7, 11 and 14, less the 2 minutes the stop adds for those who ride through.
explain.Less crowding on line 4 and the metro an: Riders who take RER G across Paris leave line 4 and the other crowded metro and RER lines, valued as line 1 at the peak; the riders left on board gain room too.
explain.Signal boxes of the surface approaches n: The signal boxes of the surface approaches are due for renewal; with the lines underground they are not renewed.
explain.Less rail noise along the approaches tha: Rail noise disappears along the surface approaches that close, for the homes beside them.
explain.Travellers of the western bypass trains:: Passengers between the west and the other regions ride a few slow bypass trains a day today; the project gives them an hourly through train by Paris, shorter by up to an hour.
explain.Travellers who leave the plane for a thr: Air passengers between French cities and from London who take the through train once it matches the plane door to door.
explain.Fares of the new cross-France journeys k: The margin and the track charges the railway keeps on the cross-France journeys the project adds.
explain.Carbon: flights replaced by through trai: The flights those passengers no longer take, at the official value of carbon, with contrails.
explain.Carbon and roads: car trips replaced on: A quarter of the new cross-France journeys replace a car trip of several hundred kilometres.
explain.A regular timetable: easy to read, easy: Every direction leaves at the same minutes all day from a known platform: easy to remember, even intervals, and a known place for each train after an incident.
explain.TGV travellers arrive later: a known thr: A train that stops at a known through platform lets passengers arrive a few minutes later at the station than for a train assigned at the last moment.
explain.Carbon emitted by the works: The carbon of digging the tunnels and the stations, at the official value.
explain.Cost of raising the public money for the: The 1.2 on the public money of the items above: plots sold and signal boxes saved reduce it, the parks add to it.
explain.Wider: denser job markets, more producti: Denser job markets make firms more productive: a published elasticity applied to the access measured.
explain.Wider: people brought into work: Better access brings a few hundred people into work.
explain.Wider: workers moving to better jobs: Better access lets workers take jobs that suit them better.
explain.Wider: cities joined, wider markets: Cities joined without a change widen each other’s markets.
explain.Wider: business time, imperfect competit: Business time saved counts 1.1 in the French sensitivity rule for imperfect competition.
